# ffxf_vm_power_state (Resource)

Manages the desired running or stopped state of a virtual machine. Removing this resource does not change VM power state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ffxf_vm_power_state" "example" {
  vm_id  = 123
  state  = "running"
  method = "graceful"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `state` (String) Desired VM state: running or stopped.
- `vm_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the virtual machine.

### Optional

- `method` (String) Power operation method: graceful (default) or forced. Graceful shutdown uses shutdown; forced stop uses stop.
- `reboot_trigger` (String) Changing this value triggers a reboot action.
